title: Cr(III)-incorporated Fe(III) hydroxides for enhanced redox conversion of As(III) and Cr(VI) in acidic solution
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01068J, Paper
Juanjuan Liu, Xubo Gao, Chong Dai, Suona Zhang, Shuqiong Kong, Lin Wang, Yandi Hu
Cr-incorporation decreased the particle size of Fe hydroxides and promoted their intermediate formation, thus As/Cr removal was increased by promoting the adsorption and catalytic efficiency of Fe hydroxides.
